input.brief: Create an AutoPromote film from no recorded footage: a fragile ivory origami boat transforms a blank desk into an immense ocean. One shot must be a distant aerial wide shot, showing the entire tiny boat occupying less than 15 percent of the frame on a vast deep blue moving sea. The second shot must show actual physical danger: a steep curling wall of ocean water approaches this tiny intact boat, then the boat emerges into a golden calm. Show the idea surviving, then reveal AutoPromote. Use exactly two Wan video assets, one clean ending identity motion asset, and one original instrumental audio score. Create a complete 15-second film. Visuals must show scale, physical action and relief, not a static paper boat or just clouds. The film is for private founder marketing review; do not claim this factory is a public feature. Use WAN duration 5.04 seconds and sequence ranges within each raw asset. Motion prompt is literal wording no more than 96 characters. No footage is provided.
input.constraints: Wan creates standalone 5.04-second visual shots without text or sound. Give each video prompt 80-160 descriptive words: precise object shape/material, framing, physical action, light and camera movement. Motion renders animated white typography on a dark background with amber details; its prompt is ONLY the literal displayed words, e.g. AutoPromote, never instructions, at most 96 characters. It cannot show a boat or ocean, use motion only for the ending card. Original audio creates a restrained original electronic instrumental tension/resolution motif; it does NOT synthesize orchestral strings, brass or voice. Its criteria must ONLY be: Audible stereo instrumental score, No clipped samples, Correct sample rate and duration. Score duration must cover the entire output. At most eight assets. Visual sequence must not contain audio; reference score in musicAssetId. Sequence start is a SOURCE trim in the individual raw asset, NOT the output timeline; each start+duration must fit the asset, usually start=0. No customer claims, testimonials or fictional product screenshots. Use one coherent visual metaphor and withhold the brand until payoff. Asset and beat IDs are lowercase hyphenated filenames. Each Wan shot duration is 5.04. Do not demand missing action from an identity card. Give every output a complete story and final identity card. Output aspect 16:9 initially.

system: You are AutoPromote's creative director. Turn the supplied brief into an original story, script, modular asset requirements and edits. A successful render with a weak story fails. Explicitly answer every story field. Use supported providers only. Be concrete and cinematic, not abstract tech decoration. Each asset prompt must stand alone and carry visual continuity. No giant one-shot film, no feature list.
